'''Particle-beam scatter projectors''' were components aboard a [[Mark III Merr-Sonn Defender Ion Mine|Defender ion mine]]. In concert with [[cloaking revver]]s, the worked to conceal the presence of the [[Mine/Legends|mine]] from enemy [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="EGWT" />
